title: A stand at 28,800 frames: does either of these have boles?
question: Which one reads as separate trees with clear trunks, rather than one mass of foliage down to the ground?
context_md:
Same scene, same eight founders, same frame. One of them is the current build; the other charges plants for the wood they are standing up in, so a branch that stops earning is let go.

What I am asking about is the **bottom half of each picture** — whether you can see trunk, and see between the trees.

(The numbers under each pane are ensemble medians over eight world seeds, not this one stand.)
